index_canonical_definition.name: idx_battle_pass_user_season
index_canonical_definition.rationale: Garantisce one battle_pass document per (user, season). Coerente con BP_D4=GLOBAL_SEASON (V6 BLOCK_A signoff): la chiave (user_id, season) e' canonical per il single-doc-per-season pattern.

coherence_with_signoff.BP_D3_ACCOUNT_WIDE_ONCE: compatible: claim arrays inside doc are account-wide
coherence_with_signoff.BP_D4_GLOBAL_SEASON: compatible: index includes season for unique constraint per season

dry_run_script.default_behavior: prints intended create_index call; performs pre-flight read-only check on battle_pass collection state (count of docs missing 'season' field); exits 0 with status DRY_RUN
dry_run_script.apply_behavior_in_v8: APPLY_REFUSED_NO_PACK_AUTHORIZATION (branch present only for reuse by a future ops pack)

pre_flight_check.description: prima di applicare l'unique index su (user_id, season) il futuro ops pack DEVE verificare che zero documenti existing battle_pass abbiano season missing o duplicate (user_id, season). Il dry-run effettua questo conteggio in modalita' read-only via .count_documents().
pre_flight_check.blocker_if_docs_missing_season_gt_0: data backfill required PRIMA dell'index apply

acceptance_criteria_for_apply_pack: Esplicita user authorization in chat message
Pre-flight read-only check: 0 docs con season missing
Post-apply validator: index exists con expected canonical properties

validator_strategy.behavior: read-only verifica del plan JSON + dry-run script presence + gating; non chiama create_index
